_about: Per-audit routing and fix knowledge for Lighthouse 13+. lane = which fixer handles it; metrics = what it moves; fix = preferred pattern; avoid = known bad fixes; verify = how to check. Edited by hand, tuned by evals.

render-blocking-insight.plain: The browser must download some CSS or JS files before it can show anything.
render-blocking-insight.fix: Inline the small CSS needed for the first screen, load the rest without blocking (media/onload swap or <link rel=preload as=style>). Remove CSS @import chains. Give every non-critical <script> in <head> defer (or type=module). Delete stylesheets or libraries the page does not use.
render-blocking-insight.avoid: Do not make the stylesheet async if that causes a flash of unstyled content above the fold. Do not move scripts to async if they depend on each other's order; use defer, which keeps order.
render-blocking-insight.verify: No CSS or sync JS listed under render-blocking requests; the first screen still looks the same.

lcp-discovery-insight.plain: The browser finds the main image late, so it starts downloading it late.
lcp-discovery-insight.fix: Put the LCP image in the initial HTML as a real (or ) with src, not injected by JS or set as a CSS background. Remove loading=lazy from it. Add fetchpriority=high. If it must stay a CSS background, add in . The image URL must be in the HTML the server sends: a script that adds the or a preload (even an inline script in ) is not discoverable and still fails.
lcp-discovery-insight.avoid: Never lazy-load the LCP image. Do not preload images that are below the fold. Keep any A/B or personalization logic working (choose the variant server-side or default to the current one in HTML).
lcp-discovery-insight.verify: lcp-discovery-insight passes: request is discoverable in the initial document, not lazy, fetchpriority=high.

lcp-breakdown-insight.plain: Shows which phase of showing the main content is slow: server, discovery, download or render.
lcp-breakdown-insight.fix: Fix the biggest phase. Long resource load delay: make the LCP resource discoverable early (see lcp-discovery). Long load duration: shrink the file (modern format, right size). Long element render delay: remove render-blocking CSS/JS and fonts with font-display:block; avoid hiding the hero until JS runs (opacity:0 animations, client-only rendering).
lcp-breakdown-insight.avoid: Do not shrink the image if render delay is the real bottleneck; the saved time just moves.
lcp-breakdown-insight.verify: The dominant LCP phase shrinks on the next run.

image-delivery-insight.plain: Images are bigger files than they need to be.
image-delivery-insight.fix: Resize each image to at most 2x its displayed width (check the report's displayed size), convert to WebP or AVIF (quality ~75-80), and serve responsive sizes with srcset/sizes. Keep the original file name pattern or update every reference. Add loading=lazy and decoding=async to images below the fold only.
image-delivery-insight.avoid: Do not lazy-load the LCP/hero image. Do not change the visible crop or aspect ratio. Keep alt text. When you add width/height to new responsive images, make sure CSS keeps height:auto so they don't stretch.
image-delivery-insight.verify: image-delivery-insight estimated savings near zero; images look the same.

cls-culprits-insight.plain: Things on the page move after it first appears, so people tap the wrong thing.
cls-culprits-insight.fix: Find each shifting element in the report. For images/iframes/embeds: set width and height attributes or CSS aspect-ratio. For content injected later (banners, widgets, ads, cookie bars): reserve its space with a fixed min-height container rendered in the HTML, or overlay it (position:fixed/sticky) so it does not push content. For web fonts: use font-display:optional or a size-adjusted fallback.
cls-culprits-insight.avoid: Do not delete the banner/widget or hide it from the test. Do not set display:none on it to pass the audit.
cls-culprits-insight.verify: CLS below 0.1 and the injected element still appears.

unsized-images.plain: Images have no set size, so the page jumps when they load.
unsized-images.fix: Add width and height attributes matching each image's intrinsic aspect ratio (CSS can still make it responsive with width:100%; height:auto). Before adding the attributes, check every CSS rule that sizes that image: if CSS sets width but not height, add height:auto (or aspect-ratio) or the image will stretch to the attribute height.
unsized-images.avoid: Do not set a height that distorts the image. After the change, check that each image's displayed width/height ratio still matches the file's.

font-display-insight.plain: Text stays invisible while custom fonts download.
font-display-insight.fix: Use font-display:swap (or optional for body text) in every @font-face. Serve WOFF2 instead of TTF/OTF (convert with fonttools if available) and subset if large. Preload only the one or two fonts used above the fold.
font-display-insight.avoid: Do not drop the brand font entirely unless asked.
font-display-insight.verify: font-display-insight passes; text appears immediately in fallback.

document-latency-insight.plain: The page's HTML itself arrives slowly or uncompressed.
document-latency-insight.fix: Compress text responses (gzip or brotli for HTML, CSS, JS, SVG, JSON), avoid redirects to the final URL, and cache or speed up server rendering.
document-latency-insight.avoid: Do not compress already-compressed formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, WOFF2, MP4).
document-latency-insight.verify: document-latency-insight passes; Content-Encoding is set on HTML.

cache-insight.plain: Files are re-downloaded on every visit because they are not cached.
cache-insight.fix: Send long-lived caching for versioned static assets (Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for hashed file names; otherwise a shorter max-age like 1 day plus ETag). Keep HTML short-lived or no-cache. For third-party files you cannot control, note them for the vendor.
cache-insight.avoid: Do not cache HTML for a long time; content updates would be stuck.
cache-insight.verify: cache-insight savings near zero for first-party files.

network-dependency-tree-insight.plain: Critical files load one after another in a long chain.
network-dependency-tree-insight.fix: Shorten the chain: remove CSS @import, inline or preload what the first screen needs, add preconnect only for third-party origins used early (max 2-4).
network-dependency-tree-insight.avoid: Do not add preconnects for origins not used on load.

legacy-javascript-insight.plain: Old-browser code ships to modern browsers who don't need it.
legacy-javascript-insight.fix: Remove polyfills for features all supported browsers have (Array/Object/Promise/fetch helpers). If a bundler exists, target modern browsers (browserslist) or ship a module/nomodule split.
legacy-javascript-insight.avoid: Do not remove code the site still calls; search for usages first.

duplicated-javascript-insight.plain: The same library is shipped more than once.
duplicated-javascript-insight.fix: Keep one copy of each library (the one loaded first) and remove the duplicate; make sure the code that uses it still finds it.

unused-javascript.plain: Most of some JavaScript files is never used on this page.
unused-javascript.fix: For first-party files: remove dead code and unused polyfills, split code so each page loads only what it uses, defer the rest. For tag managers and third parties: load them after the page is interactive or on consent, and remove unused tags in the tag manager (owner: marketing ops).
unused-javascript.avoid: Do not delete analytics or tags without listing them for the owner. Do not break features that run on interaction.
unused-javascript.verify: unused-javascript savings drop for first-party files.

unused-css-rules.plain: Most of some CSS files is never used.
unused-css-rules.fix: Remove the unused UI kit/stylesheet or replace it with only the classes the site uses (search the HTML/templates for each class before deleting). Inline the critical part.
unused-css-rules.avoid: Do not remove classes that templates or JS add at runtime (search scripts too).

unminified-css.plain: CSS has extra whitespace and comments.
unminified-css.fix: Minify CSS in the build or on deploy.

unminified-javascript.plain: JavaScript has extra whitespace and comments.
unminified-javascript.fix: Minify JS in the build or on deploy.

bootup-time.plain: Scripts take a long time to run while the page loads.
bootup-time.fix: Find the scripts with the most execution time. Defer work not needed for the first screen until first interaction or idle time (requestIdleCallback, or on focus/click of the feature that needs it). Break long loops into chunks that yield (setTimeout/scheduler.yield). Move heavy computation to a Web Worker. For third parties, load later or remove.
bootup-time.avoid: Do not delete features. If work is moved to first interaction, the feature must still work on first use.
bootup-time.verify: TBT and bootup-time drop; the feature still works.

forced-reflow-insight.plain: Scripts force the browser to recalculate layout over and over.
forced-reflow-insight.fix: Batch DOM reads before writes; avoid reading offsetWidth/getBoundingClientRect right after changing styles in a loop; use requestAnimationFrame for visual updates.

inp-breakdown-insight.plain: A tap or click takes too long to show a response.
inp-breakdown-insight.fix: Find the slow interaction handlers. Show visual feedback first, then yield (await scheduler.yield() or setTimeout) before heavy work; move non-urgent work out of the handler; reduce DOM size updated per interaction.
inp-breakdown-insight.verify: Interaction to Next Paint under 200 ms in a trace of the same interaction.

third-parties-insight.plain: Outside services (tags, chat, analytics) slow the page.
third-parties-insight.fix: List each third party with its cost. For each: remove if unused, load after interaction or on consent, or use the vendor's lighter embed (facade for chat/video). Most of this lives in the tag manager or CMS settings, not code.
third-parties-insight.avoid: Never silently remove tracking or marketing tools; produce a list for the owner to approve.

dom-size-insight.plain: The page has a very large number of elements.
dom-size-insight.fix: Render long lists lazily, remove hidden duplicate markup (mobile + desktop copies), replace icon fonts or inline SVG duplicates with a sprite.

total-byte-weight.plain: The page downloads a lot of data in total.
total-byte-weight.fix: Address the biggest files listed (usually images, video, fonts, scripts) with the matching card.

modern-http-insight.plain: Files are served over old HTTP/1.1.
modern-http-insight.fix: Serve over HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 (CDN or host setting).

viewport-insight.plain: The page isn't set up for phones.

non-composited-animations.plain: Animations make the browser redo layout every frame.
non-composited-animations.fix: Animate transform and opacity instead of top/left/width/height/margin.

image-alt.plain: Images have no description for screen readers.
image-alt.fix: Add alt text that says what the image shows or does (logo: company name; decorative: alt="").

button-name.plain: A button has no name, so screen readers say just 'button'.
button-name.fix: Add visible text or aria-label describing the action (for a menu toggle: aria-label="Open menu", plus aria-expanded and aria-controls if it toggles a menu).

link-name.plain: A link has no readable name.
link-name.fix: Give icon or image links an accessible name (aria-label or alt on the inner image).

label.fix: Add a <label for> (visible or visually hidden) to every input; placeholder is not a label.

color-contrast.plain: Some text is too faint to read easily.
color-contrast.fix: Darken the text (or lighten the background) until contrast is at least 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. Change the design token if one exists rather than one-off overrides.
color-contrast.avoid: Do not change brand colors used elsewhere without flagging it.

html-has-lang.plain: The page doesn't say what language it's in.
html-has-lang.fix: Add lang="en" (or the right language) to <html>. In Webflow: Site settings > Localization or custom code.

heading-order.fix: Use headings in order (h1, then h2, then h3) and style them with CSS instead of picking a level for its size.

landmark-one-main.plain: The page has no main region for screen readers to jump to.
landmark-one-main.fix: Wrap the primary content in <main> (one per page).

meta-description.plain: The page has no search snippet description.
meta-description.fix: Add a unique <meta name=description> that summarizes the page in about 150 characters.

link-text.plain: Links say 'click here' or 'learn more' instead of where they go.
link-text.fix: Rewrite link text to say what the destination is (for example 'See plans and pricing').

crawlable-anchors.plain: Some links can't be followed by search engines.
crawlable-anchors.fix: Give every <a> a real href; use <button> for actions that aren't navigation.

robots-txt.avoid: Do not block CSS or JS.

errors-in-console.plain: The page throws errors in the browser console.
errors-in-console.fix: Fix each error at its source: define or guard missing functions, fix broken URLs. For third-party errors, note them for the vendor.
errors-in-console.avoid: Do not wrap everything in try/catch to hide errors, and do not delete the feature that errors.

image-aspect-ratio.plain: Some images are stretched or squished.
image-aspect-ratio.fix: Display images at their natural aspect ratio (fix width/height) or crop with object-fit:cover.

valid-source-maps.plain: Large scripts have no source maps (debugging help).
valid-source-maps.fix: Optional: publish source maps for first-party bundles if the team wants them.

third-party-cookies.plain: Outside services set third-party cookies that browsers are restricting.
third-party-cookies.fix: List vendors for marketing ops; update or replace vendors that rely on them.

inspector-issues.plain: Chrome logged issues (often cookies or deprecated features).
inspector-issues.fix: Review the listed issues; most are third-party.

deprecations.plain: Code uses browser features that are going away.
deprecations.fix: Replace the deprecated API or update the vendor script.

agent-accessibility-tree.plain: AI agents can't tell what some controls do.
agent-accessibility-tree.fix: Fix the listed names and labels (same fixes as accessibility).

llms-txt.plain: No llms.txt summary for AI tools.
llms-txt.fix: Optional: add /llms.txt with a short site summary and key links.
